create_ListDataset: create a ListDataset wrapping an existing dataset with an optional sizes list
iterate_ListDataset: iterate over a ListDataset to yield each sample from the wrapped dataset
collate_ListDataset_samples: collate a batch of samples from a ListDataset by returning them unchanged
get_ListDataset_num_tokens: get the number of tokens at a given index using the sizes list
set_ListDataset_epoch: set the epoch on a ListDataset which performs a no-op operation
